description: This file defines the AccountChooserAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Account objects in an Android application, allowing users to select an account via a consumer callback.

classes.name: AccountChooserAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Account objects, enabling account selection with a callback.

methods.name: AccountChooserAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of accounts and a consumer callback.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for an account item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds an Account object to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of accounts in the list.
